digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and RUF rule family enablement
propositions: Enable RUF rule family in Ruff linting by adding it to [tool.ruff.lint].select and configuring exact global deferrals for RUF001, RUF002, RUF003 in [tool.ruff.lint].ignore

Resolve 179 actionable RUF diagnostics across src/rebar and tests using safe and reviewed unsafe Ruff fixes, targeting RUF059 (unused unpacking), RUF022/RUF023 (sorted collections), RUF012 (ClassVar annotations), RUF043 (raw-string patterns), and related codes

Extend the ratchet test (test_ruff_ratchet.py) to assert RUF is in lint.select, verify exact three-item ignore set, confirm no extend-ignore exists, and deterministically reject RUF codes from per-file-ignores
Remove stale RUF100 noqa suppressions under the full configured rule set after RUF enablement, excluding narrow-selection artifacts from the remediation count
Verify baseline narrow command exits 0, full lint exits 0, and test tier passes before landing the RUF ratchet
